response.sql: WITH counts_by_hand AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM manager_award ma INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT throws, cnt, CAST(cnt AS NUMERIC) / SUM(cnt) OVER () as share FROM counts_by_hand), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_val FROM shares), filtered AS (SELECT s.throws, s.cnt, s.share, asc.avg_share_val FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc WHERE s.share > asc.avg_share_val) SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_counts, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share_val) as avg_excess FROM filtered
